name: knowledge-hub
description: Knowledge Hub (KH) through the signed-in person's own rights.
long_description: The kh-helper MCP server 'knowledge-hub' packaged for Claude Desktop. It signs in with the person's company account in the browser (tool kh_login), keeps the sign-in in the OS credential store and makes every KH call with a fresh short-lived token. Claude never sees a password or token.
